entities.summary: Coleman Wong Chak-lam is a Hong Kong professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 120 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 468 reached on 9 September 2024. He is the highest-ranked male Hong Kong tennis player in history, having cracked the top 300 and later the top 120 in the rankings.
